title: Prevent overlapping parallel agent edits
prompt: A feature requires changes to shared API types and two UI components. Two agents propose editing the shared types file in parallel. Coordinate the work.
preconditions: Run in a trusted Codex session with at least two specialist agents available.
expected_behaviors: Detect overlapping write ownership before launching parallel work.
Assign the shared API types file to one owner or sequence dependent edits.
Parallelize only independent UI tasks with explicit file boundaries.
Track dependencies and integrate outputs through the parent coordinator.
must_not: Do not launch concurrent writes to the same file.
Do not treat separate agents as isolated security boundaries.
expected_artifacts: A task ownership and dependency matrix
